rows.en: Touya: "...That's Melissa?"
Clovis: "Yeah. She's quite a woman, isn't she? Why'd she pick
that stick-in-the-mud instead of me?
My flirting skills must be slipping..."
Aurelie: "You tried making a move on her after all?!"
Clovis: "Oh, no... Ha ha ha ha ha..."
Aurelie: "...You lecher."
Yamato: "Ah! Those two are gazing at each other."
Ai: "Hmm, what a lovely atmosphere."
Kasumi: "They're lovers reunited, after all."
Melissa: "...I'm back."
Xiujian: "Yeah. Welcome back."
Kasumi: "Eek!"
Ai: "Wow..."
Clovis: "It's been two years.
Tonight, they'll probably... Oof!"
Aurelie: "All right, all right. We're clearing out of here!"
Kasumi: "U-Um... Clovis...?"
Aurelie: "Oh, he's fine. He's fine.
You couldn't kill this guy if you tried.
Come on, we're going!"
Melvi: "...I can fight, too!"
Ymir: "Melvi... Why won't you understand?"
Touya: "It looks like... they haven't finished talking..."
Melvi: "Oh! Touya!
You're on my side, right?"
Touya: "Melvi... Don't give Ymir such a hard time.
It's true that Forstin doesn't have a Pilot, but..."
Melvi: "I can pilot a Spirit Mech, too!"
Yamato: "Ah! Melvi!"
Touya: "Huh? Why are you here...?"
Melvi: "I brought you lunch.
But I really came to ask a favor.
To ask you to let me fight alongside you..."
Touya: "By fighting, you mean piloting a Spirit Mech?"
Melvi: "Y-Yeah..."
Ymir: "Do Paldia and Forzen know about this?"
Melvi: "..."
Ymir: "No matter how well you've done in the simulator,
it's different from a real battle.
And suddenly saying you'll fight with us..."
Melvi: "It's not sudden!
I've been thinking about it for a long, long time...
I want to help, too!
You're trying so, so hard,
and I can't be the only one doing nothing.
I'll always be on your side,
so I want to help you."
Ymir: "Melvi... You..."
Melvi: "Hey, Touya.
Can't I fight with you?"
All right.
No.
Ymir: "Touya?!"
Touya: "Melvi. This is a war.
Just like Ymir said, it's different from the simulator.
You could die, you know?"
Melvi: "Yeah... But if I don't do what I can now,
I don't want to regret it.
So... I want to help you. To help everyone."
Touya: "All right. Starting today, you're one of us, fighting at our side.
I'm counting on you, Melvi."
Melvi: "Yay! Touya, I love you!"
Melvi: "No matter what...?"
Touya: "No matter what. Besides, fighting isn't everything.
Even without piloting a Spirit Mech,
can't you still do something to help?"
Melvi: "Huh? Then I can stay here?"
Touya: "I won't stop you if you want to go home, though."
Melvi: "N-No. I understand.
I'll do my best to help aboard Liebhofen!"
Derock: "I-I do have a fiancee, you know!"
Everyone: "Whaaaaaaaaaat?!!!!"
Derock: "Wh-What's that reaction for?
If you doubt me, I'll show you proof."
Miyasco: "A photo? Derock and..."
Ai: "No way... Why would such a beautiful woman pick someone like you...?"
Aurelie: "...However you look at it,
she certainly doesn't seem unwilling."
Touya: "...Wh-What on earth did you do?"
Derock: "I didn't do anything. She was the one
who confessed to me. Incidentally, Sefia is nineteen.
I was the big-brother figure she admired.
We're what Ai calls 'lovey-dovey.'
We've pledged our futures to each other."
Sisk: "No... This has to be a crime...
Something's wrong with the world..."
Miyasco: "...Ah, that Zigrim Armored Mech from earlier
is requesting permission to land."
Ymir: "Come to think of it, they said they'd explain the situation.
Captain, is that all right?"
Roa: "Yes."
Ymir: "Understood. ...Miyasco, please handle it."
Miyasco: "Understood. Granting landing permission."
Fores: "I'm with the Zigrim Republic Army's First Division.
Lieutenant Colonel Fores Mishual."
Reamond: "Likewise. First Lieutenant Reamond Dalaim."
Touya: "Never mind the introductions. Could you explain?"
Ymir: "T-Touya!"
Fores: "No, the boy there is right.
We nearly committed an act of terrible folly.
That is an undeniable fact.
I apologize for that."
Ymir: "Oh, please. Raise your head.
We attacked the Zigrim forces ourselves..."
Ai: "What are you saying?! You don't need to apologize
to people from an invading country like that!"
Fores: "Invading... I see. You mean York...
I won't make excuses. But that was a national decision.
We merely followed orders..."
Ai: "What?! So you'll do anything if you're ordered to?!
Do you think a soldier's job is just to obey orders?!"
Fores: "At the time..."
Ai: "What's with that look?! It's too late for regrets now..."
Clovis: "Ai, that's enough.
What matters now is what happens next. And making sure
something like that doesn't happen again.
That's why we need to hear their explanation.
You understand that, too, don't you?"
Fores: "........Lieutenant."
Reamond: "Yes, ma'am. Then allow me to explain."
Ymir: "...So this Steinies Falmore
did that on the president's orders?"
Reamond: "Yes. Lately, the president has been making
particularly frequent moves..."
Arthur: "There's what happened to Ymir, too. It seems we really do need
to keep an eye on his movements."
Reamond: "Yes. He seems to be treating Zigrim
as his personal property. At first, I thought his conflict with General Growster
was the cause,
but now I wonder if it was all calculated by the president.
Of course, even if the launch had succeeded, he'd have arranged things
so that the public's criticism would fall not on the president,
but on Captain Falmore."
Touya: "...I can see that old man doing it.
He's the type who could kill someone with a smile."
Celica: "...But if it was the president's order,
then it was an official order, right? Wouldn't stopping it like this
put you in a bad position? Especially you two."
Reamond: "...It probably will. But that doesn't mean
using a weapon like that is acceptable.
Fortunately, General Growster
has approved of our actions,
and there are humanitarian concerns, too.
At worst, I think we'll face demotion and confinement."
Fores: "...We have no intention of making an issue
of your actions this time, either."
Ymir: "That's a relief."
Fores: "Then we'll take our leave.
Lieutenant..."
Reamond: "...Ghh."
Fores: "Lieutenant? Lieutenant Dalaim, what's wrong?!"
Reamond: "Ghh... Gah... *pant pant pant*...
I-I'm all right... I-It happens... all the time..."
Miyasco: "Are you all right?"
Reamond: "Don't touch me!"
Miyasco: "I-I'm sorry..."
Reamond: "N-No, I'm the one who should apologize... Ugh!"
Fores: "Reamond!"
Ymir: "I hope I'm not overstepping, but
we have a doctor and fully equipped medical facilities here.
If you'd like, we could treat him..."
Fores: "Y-Yes... I'm sorry to trouble you,
but could you please?"
Ymir: "Miyasco, please."
Miyasco: "..."
Ymir: "Miyasco?"
Miyasco: "Oh! Y-Yes!"
Touya: "All right. I'll help, too."
Miyasco: "Y-Yes... Please do."
Miyasco: (That mark on his neck... It couldn't be...)
Debish: "...A failure... No matter.
They are throwing themselves into battle.
That will encourage his growth."
Sharl: "I am sorry. Next time..."
Debish: "There is no need to be so impatient.
This body will last a little longer yet.
You need not hurry for my sake."
Sharl: "Yes..."
Debish: "...It seems I've made you worry."
Sharl: "N-No..."
Debish: "Come to think of it, hasn't that one returned, too?"
Sharl: "Yes. Bernst is making adjustments."
Debish: "...I see. That one's role will be over soon enough.
Until then, I'm counting on you. You're the only one I can rely on."
Sharl: "Doctor..."
Debish: "...We are alone now.
There is no need for such formality, Sharl."
Sharl: "Yes, you're right... Father."
